title: DoorDash agrees to $131.5m after payment errors affected 200,000-plus NYC workers
content: DoorDash will pay $131.5 million to settle a probe regarding its payment practices for delivery workers. The settlement will directly benefit over 260,000 Dashers, addressing both missing and late payments. An additional dispute over calculation methods for on-call pay times has also been resolved in this agreement. DoorDash has acknowledged the issues caused by technical errors and improved its payment processes.

title: George Floyd’s siblings seek accounting of $14.7m memorial GoFundMe
content: After George Floyd's untimely death in 2020, a fundraising campaign on GoFundMe amassed millions to support his family. However, his siblings are now pressing for a comprehensive audit of the funds raised, alleging an inequitable distribution of the contributions. They have called on Philonise Floyd to produce various financial records linked to the campaign. This unfolding situation emphasizes the critical importance of accountability in the handling of considerable charitable donations.

title: Idaho teacher retires, drives across US to provide 30 hours of childcare a week
content: A 67-year-old retired schoolteacher from Idaho moved across the US to Delaware after her daughter became pregnant with her second child and faced high childcare costs. Mary Jo Galusha now spends about 30 hours each week caring for her granddaughter while her daughter and son-in-law work, highlighting how families are increasingly relying on grandparents for childcare.

title: Salesforce CEO blames Microsoft for not investing in OpenAI
content: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff says Microsoft's stake in OpenAI stopped his company from investing in the ChatGPT maker. Speaking on Alex Heath's Sources podcast, Benioff said Sam Altman turned him down, pushing Salesforce towards rival Anthropic. That early 2023 bet is reportedly worth about $5 billion, and Benioff believes it could earn Salesforce tens of billions as Claude maker Anthropic prepares for a public listing.

title: Wyoming storage shed turns out to be 140-year-old Chinese laundry
content: A weathered Wyoming cabin used as a storage shed for decades turned out to be a 140-year-old Chinese laundry and bathhouse owned by Sam Sing. After an eight-year effort, the historic building has been moved to a museum, where it will be restored and used to tell the story of Lander’s early Chinese community.

title: India's proposal under consideration for safe Black Sea shipping, Zelenskyy says

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy indicated readiness to support a truce if Russia responds positively. India's External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar is actively engaging with both Ukraine and Russia to mediate the conflict. Disruptions in shipping have impacted grain supplies globally, raising concerns among multiple countries.

title: Putin says record turnout shows Russians back his military agenda in Ukraine

Preliminary results indicated that United Russia secured a significant majority in the Duma. The election included voting in Ukrainian territories claimed by Russia, which Ukraine considers illegal. Amid ongoing Ukrainian drone attacks, authorities extended voting days and allowed online voting in some regions.

title: Trump weighs 90-day diesel export ban as US fuel prices hit record high: Report

This initiative comes as diesel prices have surged significantly amid international conflicts and supply disruptions. While some officials oppose the ban, others argue it could create long-term economic consequences. The discussions have intensified due to pressure from Republican lawmakers ahead of the midterm elections.

title: Africa’s richest man picks Indian PSU for $450 million refinery contract in Kenya

Dangote plans to strengthen regional energy security by reducing reliance on imports through this project. Work is scheduled to begin by the end of September as part of a larger expansion plan.

The embassy in Oman is actively coordinating the repatriation of the crew, reiterating India's commitment to ensuring safe navigation in international waters.

The institute acknowledged discussions regarding the issue while maintaining protocol adherence by its staff.

title: Donald Trump says Canada has too many immigrants, but the math doesn’t add up

In contrast, the US processes significantly more green cards through family-based categories than Canada does. India's immigrants play critical roles in both countries, particularly in skilled job sectors. Trump's comments regarding immigration have drawn criticism for being racially charged and factually inaccurate.

title: Ensure govt benefits reach all eligible, PM Modi tells mantris
content:
PM Narendra Modi

NEW DELHI: PM Narendra Modi Wednesday asked all ministers to ensure the benefits of all govt schemes and programmes reach every eligible person and to work for society's overall development. At the Chintan Shivir meeting, Modi interacted with eight groups of eight ministers each, which deliberated on improving self-efficiency, delivery, effective communication and trust-based governance. TOI has learnt that the PM interacted with each group separately and the brainstorming session went on for nearly five hours at Seva Teerth. Ministers will resume the exercise Thursday. "PM went to each table to take part in the discussion and made suggestions as well. It was an altogether different experience," said a source. The two-day brainstorming session is aimed at stocktaking, improving coordination, preparing govt's future agenda and reviewing work underway on welfare schemes.

End of Article

title: Private retailers start rationing diesel sales
content: private fuel retailers have started rationing diesel sales at their outlets amid a surge in global crude prices . the impact is limited, as the three public sector oil companies operate around 90% of the more than one lakh fuel stations in the country . retailers operating Russian oil major Rosneft-backed Nayara Energy said the cap ranged from 70 to 200 litres per transaction .

title: Oklahoma man says county plans to auction land strip inches from his home
